scientific limitations/integrity: The result concerns the exact sharp radius in Theorem 4.1 of arXiv:2607.27272v1 for its normalized pluriharmonic class. It is not identified with classical bounded-holomorphic or vector-valued Bohr radii. The fixed-parameter remainder is not uniform as the class parameter approaches one; a separate finite-transition profile covers that boundary layer. The exact source equation and sharpness proof were inspected directly. The new asymptotic argument is analytic, and the included numerical checker is only a sanity check.
title: A dimension–parameter boundary layer for sharp pluriharmonic Bohr radii
